enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Trace of Madness: You can almost hear faint, panicked voices when this item is close to you. Perhaps the latent power of this item's hint of madness could be brought out by some catalyst.
Piercing 3: The edges of this weapon have serrated edges, dealing an additional 3d6 piercing damage on each hit.

Heartseeker I: On Critical Hit: 3 to 18 Piercing damage from weapons with a x2 Critical Multiplier, 3 to 24 Piercing damage from weapons with a x3 Critical Multiplier, and 3 to 30 Piercing damage from weapons with a x4 or greater Critical Multiplier.
Screeching 8: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to pulse with sound, dealing 8d6 Sonic damage on each critical hit.
Maiming: This weapon has a twisted haft or grip and spikes along its blade, head, or point. When you score a critical hit with this weapon, it does an additional +3d8 damage.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
